summary: SharonAI Holdings Inc. filed an 8-K/A to correct terms of a securities purchase agreement. The company sold ~6.72M shares at $68.73/share and pre-funded warrants at $68.2799 for aggregate gross proceeds of ~$900 million. Net proceeds will fund a strategic compute collaboration with NVIDIA. This is a capital-raising transaction, not a special situation event. No acquisition, divestiture, activist, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, spin-off, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, or management change. The filing amends previously disclosed terms (principal amount, conversion price, registration rights) but does not constitute a transformative corporate event.
